items.title: Renew your licence or ID
items.contentHtml:
This approved publisher-feed fixture contains complete preparation guidance rather than a client-rendered shell. It does not expose a booking, payment, account or personal-information workflow.

Prepare before visiting

Review the current identification guidance and confirm the appropriate licensing office before a visit. This record does not claim live appointment availability and does not accept a licence number or payment.

The bounded item contains enough complete main content to exercise exact hashing, section extraction and candidate review without contacting ICBC.
